name: Tiñosillos (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided green over yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Tiñosillos (a wavy flag between two pines on yellow within a green bordure of ears of wheat).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially by decree on 21 January 1994 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 29 of 11 February 1994); the flag is described as cut into two halves horizontally.

features.role: Tiñosillos arms — flag between pines, bordure of wheat
